title: Mental Jealousy
text: The next day, indeed. We headed to the treatment facility where Big Sister and the others were hospitalized. Father, it seemed, had also finished his preparations and was getting ready to depart. Yuki-chan and the others had been growing splendidly, but they still needed a bit more time before they could carry riders, I say.
“Morning, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Good morning, indeed. Father, have you been resting properly?”
“That’s my line, isn’t it? You haven’t been out hunting until dawn again, have you?”
“Well, I did stay up rather late last night, but I got at least some sleep, indeed.”
“Good, if that’s true.”
Father said this with a somewhat wry smile. Health is important, after all. Keep pulling all-nighters and your cuticles and skin get all rough and dry, indeed.
“So… how’s their progress?”
“In peak condition, I say! I’ve leveled up Yuki-chan and the others plenty!”
“Gua!” “Gua!”
Yuki-chan and Kou each cried out behind me.

“If I remember what you told me, Filolials are easily influenced by their environment from birth until adulthood, right? You’re planning to have Yuki-chan become the leader—will that really work out?” Hmm… it was indeed true that I harbored a bit of unease about that.

In the first world—the White Swan world—I hadn’t raised Yuki-chan myself, and perhaps because she got along so well with the Filolial-sama I had raised, she hadn’t really shown much leadership behavior. She herself seemed to have viewed herself as more of a “retired feather.” I hadn’t even known Yuki-chan was in the village until after I’d defeated the Crimson Swine’s true form. And what’s more, in this particular loop, the other Filolial-sama were already present, so I couldn’t rule out the possibility that, like Kuu, Marine, and Midori in other loops, she might end up meek and docile. If Yuki-chan, originally a fiery-tempered White Swan, ended up without leadership qualities due to late-stage upbringing, then Kuro-chan would end up becoming the de facto leader instead.

What to do about this… This connected to something Father had once mused about in a previous loop, regarding raising Sakura-chan into a proper Filo-tan. If so, there was only one path forward. I had originally hoped and expected Yuki-chan to become the leader, so I believed things would be fine, but I resolved to make my request most earnestly, indeed.
“Now then, Yuki-chan.”
“Gua?”
I placed my hand upon Yuki-chan’s face, summoning that sparkling, radiant image I use when picking up women, and spoke to her earnestly.
“I want you to become the leader who guides all the Filolials from here on out, indeed. I truly believe you are capable of shouldering this great responsibility, I say.”
“G-Gua…”
“Wow… it’s like Motoyasu-kun is doing this weird sparkly handsome-guy thing, trying to woo Yuki-chan or something.”
“Gua, gua.”

Father and Kou spoke while watching me plead with Yuki-chan. This was, of course, the classic spirit-and-guts approach I always used to encourage the pigs! And meanwhile, in my mind, Yuki-chan from all the previous loops was, for some reason, wearing an expression of frustrated regret. And standing out among them, radiating an especially bitter… hii, tormented Filolial-sama aura, was none other than adult Yuki-chan from the loop where I reunited with Fleon-chan!?
“Y-Yuki-chan, do your best, indeed!”
“Gua!”
Leave it to me! Yuki-chan raised one wing as if to say just that. That set my mind at ease.
“And so, it seems Yuki-chan has agreed to do her best, I say!”
“You understood each other just from that little talk?”
“Gua?”
Kou tilted his head slightly.
“Kou, you just focus on getting along well with Elephant and Big Sister and the others, indeed.”
If at all possible, he must never grow to hold Father in contempt. Overcoming trauma is such a hassle, so it’s best simply never to experience it in the first place, indeed.
“Guaa?”
Oh right, I hadn’t introduced Kou to Big Sister and the others yet.
“So then, Father. How were Big Sister and the others doing?”
“They’re recovering quite well. At least until Rifana-chan can sit up on her own. Raphtalia-chan heard the story from her and kept begging me all day yesterday, saying she wants to help too.”
So Big Sister and the others were fired up as well.

“I told her she could come along when we go to purchase slaves, but she insists she wants to help with other things too—says it’s no good just always being helped. When she says that with that strained smile plastered on her face, I just can’t bring myself to refuse outright.”
Father said this looking somewhat troubled. Around this period, Big Sister did tend to push herself too hard, indeed. Even with her friend around, that much didn’t seem to change much.
“So what will you do, then?”

“For now I told her that her job is just to get a little healthier, day by day, and left it at that. It’s pretty rough too, trying to comfort her so she doesn’t cry after she wakes up screaming at night.”
Father seemed rather worn out as he said this.
“Well, this is exactly the sort of thing Kou can help with once he’s grown up, I say! Kou, learn all sorts of things from Elephant, and have fun staying over with Big Sister and the others, indeed.”
“Guaa!”
“Seems like the list of things Yuki-chan and the others need to do just keeps growing.”
It was an important role for Yuki-chan and Kou indeed. Now, how should we go about meeting up with Older Sister?
“And then there’s this too. If Older Sister were around, I think it would really lighten Father’s burden, indeed.”
“Raphtalia-chan has an older sister?”
“That’s right, indeed. She and Father get along quite well, I’d say.”
“Huh.”
“But meeting her at this particular time would be rather difficult, indeed. She moves around, so her location isn’t fixed.”
“Sounds like quite the challenge. Though it’d certainly help if she were around.”

At this point in time, going to the village still wouldn’t lead to a successful reunion, indeed. It seemed she was currently traveling around the country for a while. If Father simply hung around likely places, like taverns, he’d probably end up picking her up naturally enough… But in the case of an early reunion, the threat had usually already been cleared away thanks to the Queen’s intervention or similar connections.
“If we wait a little while… specifically, about two weeks after Father gets falsely accused, she should be at the ruins of the village where Big Sister used to live, indeed.”
“Then if we go to that village around that time with Raphtalia-chan and the others, we should be able to meet up with her.”
“Indeed.”

Well, that’s soon enough, indeed. By that time… now that I think about it, the Dracia mountain range should just barely still be active around then. But even going by Portal, we’d end up spending quite a while on leveling up regardless. …For now, this is more a time for solidifying our foundation than leveling up, so let’s set that aside. We can level up whenever it’s actually needed, indeed.
“Well then, shall we depart, indeed?”
“Right. I need to go make food for Wolf and the others too—things get pretty hectic over there with all the Filolials around.”
Father rolled up his sleeves. Meals are important, after all. And so, we secretly returned to Melromarc. It was about time to get the circus started, indeed.
“Hey, hey, the circus is starting!”
“It’s a carnival!”
“It’s a dance of darkness!”

Together with the costumed Filolial-sama, we paraded through the tent-lined town, promoting the circus. With the piping of little flutes and Filolial-sama riding atop Elephant while chanting “circus” over and over, the atmosphere alone was enough to feel festive, indeed. Elephant too, as part of the job, walked along dressed up like a slave, tied with rope and burdened with weights that weren’t actually all that heavy. The demon merchant had prepared a ceremonial sash for circus use, which was draped around Elephant’s neck. The Filolial-sama looked just a touch envious of that.
“Starting tonight, so everybody come on out and see it, alright!”

Or so the program announcement declared. Since it was still early days, exhibitions were the main attraction, indeed. There was the slave-abuse exhibition show that Father and the others had practiced, my performance dance with Wolf, Elephant’s weightlifting and game of catch, and the Filolial-sama’s in-tent races—for which I too was scheduled to participate, performing acrobatics atop a Filolial-sama’s back. Though according to the slave trader’s subordinate overseeing things, it was said to be a rather small-scale event overall.
